title: UwU SMP S3
description: This is the First mod we made for the UwU SMP S3. It add op things and is made for a semi-private smp
body:
- **The Official mod of the UwU SMP**
  
Our first mod and probably not the last !
The mod is basic and dosen't add much, we'll add more from time to time.
The items aren't really balanced, the weapons are quite hard to get but can be powerfull so be carefull if you add it on your server !

**Thanks to those guy:**
- Axo__: 3D Maker, A lot of Idea
- Mxry761400 : For the [discord](https://discord.com/invite/nhqpBJvYFz)
